metadata.title: Prepare for occupational software development tasks
1.1 Apply the software development lifecycle to a digital project, starting with research and familiarisation
Interpret a client request and separate the problem, constraints, assumptions and possible solutions
Define project context, including organisation, users, environment, stakeholders and constraints
Research the market environment, common problems, and existing hardware and software that shape a solution
Evaluate existing and potential solutions against client needs, constraints and evidence
Investigate emerging technologies in a specific project context rather than as a technology catalogue
Identify relevant regulations and personal knowledge, skill and capability gaps that affect the project
